## Recovered observations

26 points (from FA-28) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b1`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Single S-shaped curve; about 28.8 deg at Dr 0 through about 35 near Dr 0.47 to about 41 at Dr 1.0. Text phi: soil 7 about 29.8 (curve about 29 at Dr 0; Table 2-3 29); soil 8 about 36.8; soil 9 about 39. Reprinted under soils 8 and 9.
- Codex: Author curve; points and bounds omitted. Also specifications 8 and 9. Geometry and rate missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-28, printed A-55, PDF 56
